name: Two-pass chunked ray traversal for occupancy grids
aliases: Chunked ray traversal with occupancy grid
definition: A two-pass CUDA kernel launch that first counts the number of traversal steps per ray to allocate exact sample buffers, then fills those buffers with sample intervals and ray indices.
summary: Two-pass chunked ray traversal for occupancy grids accelerates sparse voxel raycasting by first counting occupied intervals per ray to allocate exact buffers, then filling them with sample data.
